docket_entries.description: ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. MATTER CONTINUED TO APRIL 2, 2021 AT 10:00 A.M. DEPT. 506. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,184.95 FILED BY BAUTISTA, RONELIA AS TO DEFENDANT 2400 PACIFIC AVENUE,LLC ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-26-2021 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE FOR SERVICE: $40.00 SERVED NOV-23-2020, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT 2400 PACIFIC AVENUE,LLC
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) HASMIK NAZARI, PROPERTY MANAGER. FILED BY DEFENDANT 2400 PACIFIC AVENUE,LLC

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-26-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-02-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506 PLAINTIFF RONELIA BAUTISTA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT 2400 PACIFIC AVENUE, LLC. REPRESENTED BY HASMIK NAZAR, PROPERTY MANAGER IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. PARTIES AGREE TO A SETTLEMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $317.00. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED IF PAYMENT IS MADE AS AGREED AND THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE, AN APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED, AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
